name: evolvo_manage_appointment
description: Cancel, confirm, or mark for rescheduling one existing appointment. Always call evolvo_find_appointments first and act on the ref the caller confirmed; the name is not used. Precondition: you named that one appointment (person, weekday, date, time), asked if it is the one they mean, ended your turn, and the caller said yes - only then send appointment_confirmed true. confirm_appointment_first: nothing changed - read read_back back in the caller's language, ask if it is the right one, end your turn, then call again with the same ref and appointment_confirmed true. ambiguous_appointment or ref_date_mismatch: nothing changed - ask which they mean and call again with that line's ref and date. Cancelling has no undo, so never cancel an unconfirmed one; a cancelled appointment stops appearing in evolvo_find_appointments. A successful cancel reports slot_released (boolean), slot_release_status and a note already written for the caller. slot_released true: the time is bookable again - if they want it back, or for someone else, look it up with evolvo_check_availability and book normally. slot_released false (still_blocked, unknown, not_checkable_same_day or check_failed): never say the time is free or offer to rebook it; say the appointment is cancelled and offer to look for another time. Say cancelled, never deleted or removed. Moving: mark first, then book - call with action reschedule and only after it succeeds run evolvo_check_availability and evolvo_book_appointment for the new time, in this same call, on the same phone number. The booking cancels this appointment automatically and returns replaced_appointment, so never call this tool again to cancel it. Booking before marking leaves the old slot blocked; a different phone number leaves the marked appointment alone. If no new time is accepted it stays marked and a colleague picks it up; do not cancel it as a tidy-up. not_found or appointment_not_found: say a colleague will call back; do not guess. Never call it twice for the same appointment.

phone.description: The same number used for evolvo_find_appointments, digits only, no spaces, no leading zero or country code added or removed.

ref.description: The ref of the one confirmed appointment, copied exactly from the evolvo_find_appointments list. Never invent one or reuse one from an earlier call.

date.description: Date of that same appointment, YYYY-MM-DD, from the same line as the ref. Cross-checked: if they disagree nothing is changed.

action.description: cancel drops it; slot_released in the response then says whether the time is bookable again. reschedule marks it as needing a new time without releasing the slot; booking a replacement on the same phone number cancels it automatically. confirm confirms attendance.

appointment_confirmed.description: true only if you named this exact appointment (person, weekday, date, time), asked if it is the one they mean, and the caller answered yes in a later turn; otherwise false. Never guess: there is no undo.

note.description: Optional short note for staff, e.g. the reason or when the caller would prefer instead.
